set.title: Full-Day Pool Access: Aloft Abu Dhabi
set.details: Full-day access to the Aloft Abu Dhabi pool. The fee is fully redeemable on food and drinks. Booked through SupperClub on Kidzapp; at least one adult per booking.
set.price_text: AED 50 per adult, AED 25 kids 6-12, under 6 free (fully redeemable on F&B)
